caption: The drawing depicts a simple wooden chair with a worn appearance. The chair has a rectangular backrest with two horizontal slats, and four straight legs connected by horizontal supports. The seat of the chair is depicted as sagging and appears to be made of a different, possibly softer, material that is frayed at the corners. The wood is colored in various shades of brown, showing areas of lighter and darker tones to suggest grain and texture, with some sections appearing more faded. The background is a light beige color, and there are no other objects or details present in the composition.
title: Side Chair
